title: Target-Free Autocalibration of Stereo PIV Camera Systems via Persistent-State Motion Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.18741v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stereo Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) recovers three-component velocity fields by triangulating tracer particles observed by synchronized cameras. It requires an accurate extrinsic calibration, which is still obtained by inserting a physical target into the flow and must be repeated whenever the rig is moved. We present a target-free method that calibrates a stereo PIV rig directly from particle image sequences. Because tracer particles are visually indistinguishable, we match motion rather than appearance: building on CUT3R, each camera stream is processed by a recurrent transformer whose persistent state accumulates particle motion over time. The state is decoded into per-camera optical flow and queried by a cross-view decoder that regresses bidirectional point correspondences, from which the relative pose is recovered with a five-point RANSAC solver. translated_title: 基于持久状态运动表示的立体PIV相机系统无靶标自标定
translated_abstract: 立体粒子图像测速（PIV）通过对同步相机观测到的示踪粒子进行三角测量来恢复三分量速度场。该技术需要精确的外参标定，而目前这一标定仍需在流场中插入物理靶标才能获得，且每当相机装置移动后都必须重新进行。我们提出了一种无需靶标的方法，可直接从粒子图像序列对立体PIV装置进行标定。由于示踪粒子在外观上不可区分，我们匹配的是运动而非外观：基于CUT3R，每个相机流由一个循环Transformer处理，其持久状态随时间累积粒子运动信息。该状态被解码为各相机的光流，并由跨视图解码器查询以回归双向点对应关系，进而通过五点RANSAC求解器恢复相对位姿。我们在一个新的带有真值位姿的合成立体PIV数据集上进行训练，并对所提方法进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需物理靶标的立体PIV相机自标定方法，利用循环Transformer的持久状态累积示踪粒子运动信息，通过跨视图点对应回归与五点RANSAC求解器直接从粒子图像序列恢复相机相对位姿。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a target-free autocalibration method for stereo PIV camera systems, which leverages a recurrent transformer's persistent state to accumulate tracer particle motion and recovers relative camera pose directly from particle image sequences via cross-view point correspondence regression and a five-point RANSAC solver.
